data.short_meaning: Greek form of Elizabeth, meaning 'God is my oath'
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Elisheba, meaning 'My God is an oath, and it is He who will complete it.' In Greek, Eleazaros, meaning 'My God helps'. Combined, the name Lazarina means 'God is my help and my oath'. The name Lazarina carries the meaning “Greek form of Elizabeth, meaning 'God is my oath'” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lazarina usually hope their child will grow to embody greek form of elizabeth, meaning 'god is my oath' and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: לזרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמה של הלזרינה הוא צורה נקבית של השם לזר, אשר משמעותו 'לשומר' או 'לתמוך'. במסורת הנוצרית, השם לזר יוחס ליוחנן 11:1-44, שבו ישו גילה תנחומים לאחותו ולחבריו לאחר מותו של לזר. השם לזרינה, אם כן, מציין את האהבה והתמיכה של ישו באנשים בקשיים. במסורת הנוצרית המאוחרת, השם לזרינה הפך למוכר כשם לאישה, ומסמל את החסד והאהבה של ישו.

in_greek.name: Λαζαρίνα
in_greek.meaning: Απάντηση για τον Λάζαρο, ψυχή του κόσμου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λάζαρίνα είναι η γυναικεία μορφή του ονόματος Λάζαρος, που σημαίνει 'να φροντίσει' ή 'να στηρίζει'. Στην Παλαιά και Νέα Διαθήκη, ο Λάζαρος είναι γνωστός ως ο άντρας που έζησε σε μια βαθιά σπαραξιμοσύνη όταν ο Ιησούς τον έγινε να ξυπνήσει από τον θάνατό του (Ιωάννης 11:1-44). Το όνομα Λάζαρίνα αναφέρεται στην αγάπη και την ενίσχυση που παρέχει ο Ιησούς στους ανθρώπους που βρίσκονται σε δύσκολη θέση. Στη μεσαιωνική Ευρώπη, το όνομα Λάζαρίνα έγινε δημοφιλές ως όνομα για γυναίκες και αναφέρεται στην αγάπη και την ενίσχυση που παρέχει ο Ιησούς.

in_latin.name: Lazarina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lazarina est forma feminina nominis Lazarus, significans 'cure' vel 'sustinere'. In Biblia, Lazarus est vir qui periebat in profundo dolore quando Iesus eum fecit resurgere a morte (Ioannes 11:1-44). Nomen Lazarina referreth ad amorem et susceptionem quae providebit Iesus hominibus in difficili loco. In Europa medievali, nomen Lazarina factum est populare ut nomen mulierum, referens ad amorem et susceptionem quae providebit Iesus.

in_english.name: Lazarina
in_english.meaning: Answer for Lazarus, soul of the world, name that denotes care and love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lazarina is the feminine form of the name Lazarus, which means 'to care for' or 'to support'. In the Bible, Lazarus is the man who was resurrected by Jesus from death (John 11:1-44). The name Lazarina refers to the love and support that Jesus provides to people in difficult situations. In medieval Europe, the name Lazarina became popular as a female given name, referring to the love and support that Jesus provides.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lazarina is rooted in two ancient cultural traditions: Hebrew and Greek. It is a beautiful fusion of the two, symbolizing the richness and depth of these two vibrant worldviews. In the Hebrew tradition, a name is a powerful reflection of the God's promises and the individual's relationship with Him. In the Greek culture, the name Eleazaros held the belief that God is a helper, with the name eliciting a sense of protection and support. The name Lazarina carries on this legacy, invoking strength and a deep connection to one's faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lazarina holds a profound spiritual significance as it underscores the idea that God is our helper and our oath; a loving and constant presence in our lives. The name serves as a reminder that our commitment and trust in God will be fulfilled, and that He is always by our side, offering guidance and strength in times of need. It is a testament to the belief that with God, we can overcome any challenge and achieve greater things.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lazarina is a feminine form of the name Lazarus, meaning "help from God" or "God's assistance". In the Bible, Lazarus was the name of a man who was raised from the dead by Jesus, symbolizing the power of God to bring new life and hope even in the face of death.

biblical_reference.note: The story of Lazarus is a famous miracle of Jesus, where he raised Lazarus from the dead.

historical_references.reference: According to traditions and medieval legends, Lazarina was the name of a Bulgarian princess in the Byzantine Empire during the 14th-15th centuries. She was known for her extraordinary beauty and piety. She is said to have been the daughter of the Bulgarian Tsar Ivan Alexander and the sister of Sisman, Despot of Serres.

Another legend tells of a Greek nun named Lazarina who lived during the late 16th century in the Monastery of the Holy Laura on Mt. Sinai. She was known for her miraculous healings using the ash of burnt lazaropita (a special sweet bread). The name Lazarina is derived from 'Lazaros' (Elazar, a Hebrew name meaning 'God is my help'), and is a variation of the name 'Lazarus' common in the Greek Orthodox tradition.
